Javob olinmadi. Qayta urinib ko‘ring — t.en: No response. Try again — nothing is written twice.

Bu F2 uchun storno allaqachon bor: {r}..en: A storno already exists for this F2: {r}. Another one would subtract twice.

Saqlab qolinadigan qatorlardan belgini o.en: Untick the rows you want to keep.

Ro‘yxat {n} qatorgacha ko‘rsatildi — qid.en: Showing up to {n} rows — narrow it with search (ticks apply to all rows).

{n} qatorning fakti ish normasidan hosil.en: {n} rows have a fact derived from the work norm (not written by hand)

o‘tgan fakt yozuvlari o‘chirilmaydi, min.ru: прошлые записи факта не удаляются, добавляется запись с минусом.
o‘tgan fakt yozuvlari o‘chirilmaydi, min.en: past fact entries are not deleted; a minus entry is added.

{n} qatorda summa noma‘lum: noma‘lum bo‘.en: {n} rows have an unknown amount: it stays unknown (not 0) and the price is marked "intentionally absent".

Storno qoralamasi yaratildi. Tasdiqlash.en: Storno draft created. Approve it on this page; add the new positions below it in "F2 preparation".

Shu F2 qatorlaridan minus (storno) qoral.en: Creates a minus (storno) draft from this F2's rows; the original F2 is untouched

{n} ta yangi qator storno bloki bilan bi.en: {n} new rows duplicated a storno-block position and were dropped.

hujjat boshida saqlanadi; yangi pozitsiy.ru: хранится в начале документа; новые позиции добавляются под этим блоком.
hujjat boshida saqlanadi; yangi pozitsiy.en: kept at the top of the document; new positions are added below this block.
